evidence.quote: PWM/servo driver | FCCPeripherals | NXP PCA9685PW (I2C 16-ch PWM), I2C addr 0x40

anomalies.impact: The PCA9685 will respond at I2C address 0x41 instead of 0x40, so firmware expecting 0x40 will not control the PWM outputs.

anomalies.observed: U5 pin 7 (PS) is connected to the +3.3V net.
anomalies.expected: PS should be tied to GND to select I2C mode for the BMI088, as the design uses I2C addresses 0x19/0x69.

evidence.quote: IMU (accel + gyro) | NAVCPeripherals | Bosch BMI088, I2C addr 0x19 (acc) / 0x69 (gyr)

anomalies.impact: The BMI088 will be configured for SPI instead of I2C, so the NAVC cannot communicate with it over the I2C bus.

anomalies.observed: FCC1 pins 48 and 73, which are VCAP pins, are connected to the UART3_TX_FCC and UART3_RX_FCC nets going to the UART3 connector.
anomalies.expected: UART3 TX/RX should connect to the MCU's UART3 pins (e.g., PB10/PB11 or PD8/PD9), not to VCAP internal regulator pins.
anomalies.impact: The UART3 interface is connected to internal VCAP regulator outputs, so it will not function as a UART and may damage the MCU or connected device.
